explainer_content.short_definition: Modern heavy music where breakdowns meet huge emotional hooks.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Metalcore carries hardcore's impact and metal's riff discipline into 2000s and 2010s heavy radio, emo, and festival worlds.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It made harsh vocals and breakdowns part of a mainstream-adjacent rock vocabulary.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The distinct move is contrast: screamed pressure against clean melody, pit rhythm against chorus lift.
